Options (UTC / CET / ET):
- Option A: Wed Apr 2, 13:00 UTC / 14:00 CET / 09:00 ET (good EU morning, early US)
- Option B: Thu Apr 3, 15:00 UTC / 16:00 CET / 11:00 ET (later EU morning)
- Option C: Tue Mar 31, 17:30 UTC / 18:30 CET / 13:30 ET (works if APAC attendee can join later)

If you need APAC-friendly, propose Wed Apr 2, 06:00 UTC (07:00 CET / 23:00 AEST) — early but sometimes easiest for tri-region calls.

I'll attach a short mutual action plan draft and a demo agenda for you to review. If any of these look good, I'll send a calendar invite with a fallback slot and a recording clause (so late joiners can catch up).

Looping in Lauren/Vivek to confirm our engineer + solutions folks' availability.
